# Lesson

## Summary
The smallest unit: video, reading, live session or exercise, with duration, content and linked file cards. Live lessons carry a session time and room link.

## Usage
Linked from Module.lessons; Attendance Record links a live one.

## Non-goals
No progress tracking per learner (completion is course-level).
